stc1010_population_definition.ici_sensitivity: None — primary rationale for STC-1010 therapeutic vaccine approach
stc1010_population_definition.source: Alzeeb et al. 2024 — CT26 model (pMMR surrogate) and MC38-PD1R model (ICI-resistant surrogate)

trial_bridges.molecular_data_available: KRAS exon 2 (mut/WT), BRAF V600E (mut/WT), MMR/MSI status (MLH1/MSH2/MSH6 IHC + MLH1 methylation), 5-class tumor subtype; n=2720; DFS primary endpoint
trial_bridges.relevance_to_mss_crc: HIGH — N0147 is the definitive dataset establishing that dMMR/MSI-H patients benefit from adjuvant FOLFOX (DFS benefit) while pMMR/MSS patients do NOT. The pMMR/MSS subgroup in N0147 (majority of n=2720) represents the exact population STC-1010 targets: FOLFOX-treated, MMR-proficient, ICI-ineligible CRC patients with residual recurrence risk.
trial_bridges.bridge_use_case: N0147 pMMR/MSS subgroup provides the natural history control arm benchmark for BreAK CRC-001: DFS rates in FOLFOX-treated pMMR patients define the unmet need STC-1010 must improve upon. KRAS exon 2 data from N0147 enables KRAS-mut vs KRAS-WT subgroup stratification within the MSS population — directly relevant to STC-1010 biomarker strategy since KRAS-mut MSS CRC is the primary target.
trial_bridges.data_gap: N0147 is adjuvant (Stage III); BreAK CRC-001 is metastatic. N0147 KRAS data is exon 2 only (not expanded RAS). No NRAS, no KRAS exon 3/4 data. No immune infiltration or TME data. No bevacizumab arm.

trial_bridges.molecular_data_available: Expanded RAS panel: KRAS exon 2/3/4 + NRAS exon 2/3/4 + BRAF exon 15; RAS-WT PFS HR=0.72, OS HR=0.78 (panitumumab + FOLFOX4 vs FOLFOX4); RAS-mut: no benefit or harm from panitumumab
trial_bridges.relevance_to_mss_crc: HIGH — PRIME defines the RAS mutation landscape in mCRC and establishes that RAS-mutant patients (KRAS or NRAS any exon) derive no benefit from EGFR-targeted therapy. Since ~40-45% of MSS CRC is KRAS-mutant and KRAS-mut MSS CRC is the primary STC-1010 target population (ICI-ineligible, EGFR-therapy-ineligible, chemotherapy-only), PRIME's RAS-mut subgroup provides the benchmark OS/PFS for the STC-1010 target population on mFOLFOX6 backbone.
trial_bridges.bridge_use_case: PRIME RAS-mut OS data (HR=0.78 favoring FOLFOX4 alone over panitumumab+FOLFOX4 in RAS-mut) establishes that KRAS/NRAS-mutant MSS mCRC patients are a chemotherapy-only population with defined survival outcomes. STC-1010 + mFOLFOX6 in BreAK CRC-001 can be benchmarked against PRIME RAS-mut FOLFOX4 arm OS/PFS as a historical comparator for the KRAS-mut MSS subgroup. Oracle can classify the full expanded RAS panel to enable this subgroup analysis.
trial_bridges.data_gap: PRIME does not report MSI/MMR status — cannot confirm all RAS-mut patients are MSS. No bevacizumab arm in PRIME. FOLFOX4 vs mFOLFOX6 backbone differences. No immune biomarkers.

trial_bridges.molecular_data_available: DFS HR=0.80 (FOLFOX4 vs LV5FU2), OS HR=0.84; Stage II/III subgroups; ZERO molecular columns — no KRAS, no MMR, no RAS data
trial_bridges.relevance_to_mss_crc: MEDIUM — MOSAIC established FOLFOX as adjuvant standard of care for Stage III CRC (and high-risk Stage II). As the foundational FOLFOX efficacy trial, MOSAIC provides the backbone chemotherapy benchmark for BreAK CRC-001's mFOLFOX6 component. However, absence of molecular data means MOSAIC cannot be used for MSS-specific or KRAS-specific subgroup benchmarking.
trial_bridges.bridge_use_case: MOSAIC DFS/OS data serves as the historical efficacy floor for mFOLFOX6 backbone in BreAK CRC-001. The HR=0.80 DFS benefit establishes what chemotherapy alone achieves; STC-1010 must demonstrate incremental benefit above this floor. No molecular subgroup bridging is possible due to zero molecular data.
trial_bridges.data_gap: Zero molecular data — no MSI, no KRAS, no RAS, no BRAF. Adjuvant setting (Stage II/III) vs BreAK CRC-001 metastatic setting. Cannot stratify by MSS status. Cannot identify KRAS-mut subgroup. Entirely non-informative for biomarker strategy.

trial_bridges.molecular_data_available: OS HR=0.817 (P=0.0032) for aflibercept + FOLFIRI vs placebo + FOLFIRI; ZERO molecular columns — no KRAS, no MMR, no RAS, no BRAF data
trial_bridges.relevance_to_mss_crc: LOW-MEDIUM — VELOUR is an angiogenesis trial (aflibercept/VEGF-trap) in second-line mCRC. Relevant to BreAK CRC-001 only insofar as bevacizumab is an optional backbone component. VELOUR's OS HR=0.817 provides a reference for anti-angiogenic benefit magnitude in unselected mCRC, but absence of molecular data prevents MSS-specific interpretation.
trial_bridges.bridge_use_case: VELOUR OS data provides context for the anti-angiogenic component of BreAK CRC-001's bevacizumab arm: the ~18% OS improvement from VEGF blockade in unselected mCRC sets the expected contribution of bevacizumab to the control arm. STC-1010 must demonstrate benefit above the bevacizumab + mFOLFOX6 combination baseline. No molecular bridging possible.
trial_bridges.data_gap: Zero molecular data — no MSI, no KRAS, no RAS, no BRAF. Second-line FOLFIRI backbone vs first-line mFOLFOX6 in BreAK CRC-001. Aflibercept (VEGF-trap) vs bevacizumab (anti-VEGF mAb) — different mechanisms. Cannot stratify by MSS status. Entirely non-informative for biomarker strategy.

oracle_application_to_bridges.n0147_mmr_replication: Oracle can replicate N0147's MMR classification pipeline (MLH1/MSH2/MSH6 variant pathogenicity + IHC integration) to prospectively confirm pMMR/MSS status in BreAK CRC-001 patients, with 0.957 AUROC exceeding standard IHC sensitivity.
oracle_application_to_bridges.prime_ras_replication: Oracle can classify the full PRIME expanded RAS panel (KRAS+NRAS exon 2/3/4 + BRAF exon 15) to enable KRAS-mut MSS subgroup identification in BreAK CRC-001 — the primary target population for STC-1010.
oracle_application_to_bridges.mosaic_velour_limitation: No Oracle application possible for MOSAIC/VELOUR molecular bridging — zero molecular data in both trials. Oracle can only be applied prospectively in BreAK CRC-001.

key_insight: N0147's pMMR/MSS subgroup (the population that did NOT benefit from FOLFOX-based immunotherapy augmentation) combined with PRIME's KRAS-mut RAS-expanded data together define the exact STC-1010 target: KRAS-mutant, pMMR/MSS mCRC patients who are ineligible for both ICI and EGFR-targeted therapy, leaving mFOLFOX6 +/- bevacizumab as the only standard option — the precise unmet need STC-1010 addresses.
